name: Tiny Desk AI Video Generator
tagline: Upload 1–4 photos to create a 10-second 9:16 Tiny Desk–style AI band video with sound.
description: TinyDesk Video turns one lead photo (plus up to three friends) into a 10-second vertical AI video inspired by a Tiny Desk–style band performance. Empty slots are filled with fictional AI performers. One-time credit packs from $7.99 — no subscription. Independent product, not affiliated with NPR.
